name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 8 visits over 57 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-10-24, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
